fieldDescription:
Sets how effective your Works and colony items are.
- Survival: Works and colony items have their default effect. The Flotilla sustains itself but has little surplus.
- Story: yield-based Works and colony items are 1.5x as effective, and global efficiency is multiplied by 1.25.

Manage this mod through an intel screen entry instead of its own Management bar button (for mod compatibility). If you don't see the manage button at the bottom, try turning this on. Takes effect on the next game load.
[Will affect balance a lot] Global multiplier on all onboard production.
Multiplier on autoforge yield in particular (affects both inputs and outputs).
Compounding population growth while every need is met and berths are free. 0.02 = 2 percent per cycle. Most growth comes from migrant pickups or crew you manually move to the Flotilla.
How long before a colony offers the Flotilla migrants again.
Whether the Flotilla status bar appears at the top of the campaign map.
